trustSection.title: Citizen Security & Official Web Standards
trustSection.description: All legitimate federal, provincial, and local government platforms operate exclusively on verified .gov.np or educational .edu.np second-level domains with Transport Layer Security (TLS/HTTPS). Always verify the URL in your browser's address bar before providing personal identity information.
